title: The Triple Threat fractures around the world title
summary: Bam Bam Bigelow turns on Shane Douglas and takes his championship. Douglas’s attempt to reclaim it makes the faction’s internal struggle a headline rivalry.

chapters.title: Bigelow takes Douglas’s championship
chapters.result: Bigelow defeats Douglas for the world title.
chapters.context: The former ally becomes the obstacle to Douglas’s control of ECW.

chapters.title: Douglas wins near home
chapters.result: Douglas defeats Bigelow to regain the world championship.
chapters.context: The victory in the Pittsburgh area begins his longest ECW world-title reign.
